title: PEANUT SOUP
instructions: --Made like a dry pea soup. Soak a pint and one-half nut meats over night in two quarts of water. In the morning add three quarts of bayleaf, stalk of celery, blade of mace and one slice of onion. Boil slowly for four or five hours, stirring frequently to keep from burning. Rub through
a sieve and return to the fire, when heated through again add one cupful of cream. Serve hot with croutons.
